core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix medical precision with soft lifestyle aesthetics
Emotion First: Calming pastels to reduce patient anxiety
Glassmorphism: Use translucent layers for depth
Bento Grid: Asymmetric, modular layout for services

layout.spacing: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) to create breathing room
layout.radius: rounded-3xl (24px) for all cards and containers

ServiceCard.content: Icon/Image on top, Title bold, Description subtle

HeroSection.style: Centered or Asymmetric with floating 3D elements (CSS shapes)
HeroSection.elements: Large gradient heading, Pill-shaped CTA, Trust badges

AuthModal.style: Clean, centered dialog with pastel accents. Keep existing logic intact.

Buttons.primary: bg-teal-500 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-teal-600 shadow-lg hover:shadow-teal-500/30 transition-all
Buttons.secondary: bg-white text-teal-600 border border-teal-100 rounded-full hover:bg-teal-50

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update `tailwind.config.js` to include the new pastel color palette and fonts.
2. Refactor `Home.js` to use the new Bento Grid layout.
3. Replace the existing `services` array images with the new Unsplash URLs provided in `assets.images`.
4. Apply Glassmorphism styles to all cards (`bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-md`).
5. Ensure `AuthModal` logic remains 100% functional but update its UI to match the pastel theme.
6. Add floating background blobs (using CSS absolute positioning and blur) to the main container for that 'soft' feel.
8. Preserve all `onClick` handlers and navigation paths.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use tinted grays (#1E293B).
Ensure accessibility contrast ratios are met even with pastel colors.
